FINDINGS backcompat PR#6033 @0bb60235132cc72daea81427107a40ba1ccb5ddf
- path: notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb
  line: 240
  side: LEFT
  severity: P1
  confidence: 0.99
  reachability: routine
  kind: backcompat
  title: Keep standalone notebook runner imports
  claim: The alternative Colab runner cells no longer import modules they use, so either runner fails when selected independently.
  detail: The localtunnel cell still uses `time`, `socket`, `urllib.request`, and `subprocess`, while the iframe cell uses `time` and `socket`; those imports now exist only in the cloudflared alternative. A user following either documented alternative from a fresh runtime gets a background-thread `NameError` rather than a tunnel/iframe, so each runnable cell must retain or reliably obtain its dependencies.
  evidence: `notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb:242-253` references the four removed imports; `notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb:287-302` references `time` and `socket`; the imports were removed at base `notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb:240-244`.
  fix: Restore the required imports in each standalone runner cell or move them to an unconditional setup cell.

FINDINGS placement PR#6033 @0bb60235132cc72daea81427107a40ba1ccb5ddf
- path: ruff.toml
  line: 9
  side: RIGHT
  severity: P3
  confidence: 0.98
  reachability: routine
  claim: The `ignore = ["ALL"]` policy overrides the new `F` selection, so Pyflakes rules remain disabled in CI.
  evidence: ruff.toml:2 ignores every rule while ruff.toml:9 selects `F`; .github/workflows/ruff.yml:23 runs `ruff check .`.
  fix: Remove the blanket ignore or replace it with only the intended exclusions.
- path: ruff.toml
  line: 9
  side: RIGHT
  severity: P3
  confidence: 0.99
  reachability: routine
  claim: Applying module-level Pyflakes rules to the notebook caused independent launch cells to lose their required imports.
  evidence: notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb:242-258 uses `time`, `socket`, `urllib`, and `subprocess` after their cell-local imports were removed; the preceding cloudflared cell starts `main.py` at line 220 and therefore is not a usable prerequisite for the localtunnel alternative.
  fix: Preserve each launch cell’s imports and exempt the notebook’s intentional cross-cell redefinitions in the Ruff configuration.

FINDINGS baseline PR#6033 @0bb60235132cc72daea81427107a40ba1ccb5ddf
- path: ruff.toml
  line: 9
  side: RIGHT
  severity: P1
  confidence: 0.98
  reachability: routine
  claim: The configuration still ignores every Ruff rule, so selecting `F` does not enforce any Pyflakes checks.
  detail: Ruff applies `lint.ignore` after rule selection; `lint.ignore = ["ALL"]` at line 2 suppresses the newly selected `F` family (and `S307`), causing the CI `ruff check .` invocation to pass without reporting the rules this PR claims to enable. The configuration must leave the selected rules unignored.
  evidence: ruff.toml:2 ignores `ALL` while ruff.toml:5-10 selects `S307` and `F`; .github/workflows/ruff.yml:23 invokes `ruff check .`, which consumes this configuration.
  fix: Remove the blanket ignore or replace it with explicit exclusions that do not overlap selected rules.
- path: notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb
  severity: P1
  confidence: 0.96
  reachability: routine
  claim: The alternative Colab launch cells now reference modules they no longer import, so they fail when run as the documented alternatives.
  detail: The localtunnel cell uses `time`, `socket`, `urllib.request`, and `subprocess`, and the iframe cell uses `time` and `socket`, but this change removed their imports from those cells. The cloudflared cell cannot supply them in normal alternative use because it starts a foreground server; selecting either alternative in a fresh Colab runtime leaves the thread failing with `NameError` and no accessible tunnel/iframe. Each runnable launch option must import its own dependencies.
  evidence: notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb:238-260 imports only `threading` but references `time` (244), `socket` (245), `urllib.request` (252), and `subprocess` (253); notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb:286-302 likewise imports only `threading` but references `time` (289) and `socket` (290). The removed imports existed in these cells in the merge-base diff.
  fix: Restore the required imports in each independent launcher cell.

FINDINGS validation PR#6033 @0bb60235132cc72daea81427107a40ba1ccb5ddf
- path: notebooks/comfyui_colab.ipynb
  line: 240
  side: LEFT
  severity: P1
  confidence: 0.99
  reachability: routine
  claim: Removing cell-local imports breaks both alternative Colab launch cells in a fresh runtime, preventing their tunnels from starting.
  detail: First localtunnel cell now imports only threading but uses time, socket, urllib.request, and subprocess; the iframe cell imports only threading but uses time and socket. Imports exist in the cloudflared alternative cell, but it starts foreground main.py and is not an unconditional setup cell, so users selecting either alternative receive NameError failures.
  evidence: The deleted imports were at base lines 240-244 and 291-292; the resulting localtunnel cell references the missing names at current lines 244-253, while the iframe cell references them at current lines 289-290.
  fix: Restore each alternative cell’s dependencies locally or move them into an unconditional setup cell.

- baseline-config ruff.toml:9 — refuted — Ruff resolves select/ignore conflicts by prefix specificity, so the more-specific `F` selection at ruff.toml:9 overrides the broad `ALL` ignore at ruff.toml:2.
